Comment: M7 extraction pipeline (D-035, docs/architecture/reviews/m7-extraction-design/claude-reconciliation-final-design.md, GATE 9.2/9.3). RunTextract is the ONLY real Task state implemented so far (item 4, TextractTaskHandler) - every other state below is a placeholder/stub referencing Lambdas from items 5-7 (PdfParserTaskHandler, BedrockExtractionTaskHandler, ExtractionValidationTaskHandler), which do not exist yet. This file documents the intended shape; it MUST NOT be applied via a real aws_sfn_state_machine resource until those Lambdas exist (a Task referencing a non-existent function ARN fails terraform apply, not just runtime) - see infra/modules/extraction-workflow/ (parameterized by Lambda ARN variables, deliberately not called from infra/main.tf yet) and NEXT_SESSION_PROMPT.md for wiring status.

RunTextract.Comment: The only real Task state for this phase (design §2, rodada 5 correction: no separate DetectDocumentType state - classification happens INSIDE this single TextractTaskHandler invocation, per §1.2). Sequence inside the handler: classify -> OCR kill switch -> reserve AI_CALL quota -> StartDocumentTextDetection -> persist TextractJob, then return (no SendTaskSuccess here - the execution stays parked on taskToken until a LATER, separate SQS-triggered COMPLETE_OCR invocation resolves it via SendTaskSuccess/Failure).

Catch.Comment: UnsupportedDocumentType (classifier), OcrDisabled (kill switch), TextractUnsupportedDocument/TextractPartialFailure/TextractJobPersistenceFailed (Textract-time failures), and any timeout/unclassified error - ALL fall through to the deterministic parser, never straight to MarkPendingConfirmation (design §1.2 rodada-3 correction).

RunDeterministicParser.Comment: STUB - references PdfParserTaskHandler (item 5, not yet implemented). Runs a deterministic parser over the OCR artifact (when present) to produce candidate field values, per implementation-blueprint.md §12.5. A RunTextract failure above (ocrFailure present) still reaches this state and must run degraded (no OCR text, parser tries file-metadata-only heuristics or returns no candidates) - never skipped.

Catch.Comment: The ONE failure that goes straight to MarkPendingConfirmation without trying Bedrock - a RunDeterministicParser failure itself, per design §1.2.

NeedsBedrock.Comment: STUB - evaluates decide-bedrock.ts's needsBedrock() contract (design §1.10) over the deterministic candidates. Real condition to be wired once ExtractionValidationTaskHandler (item 7) produces the BedrockDecisionInput shape as Step Functions JSONPath.

CheckAiKillSwitch.Comment: STUB - AI_EXTRACTION kill switch gate before any paid Bedrock call, fail-closed per design §1.5.

RunBedrock.Comment: STUB - references BedrockExtractionTaskHandler (item 6, not yet implemented). Converse API, prompt isolation per design §1.11, BedrockExtractionRequest carries only textArtifact (never raw OCR text), AI_CALL quota reserved before the call.

ValidateSchema.Comment: STUB - first of 4 distinct Task states from ExtractionValidationTaskHandler (item 7, not yet implemented), per design §2's closing paragraph (kept as separate states for per-stage audit/Catch, overhead is negligible next to Textract/Bedrock).

CompareExtractors.Comment: STUB - compares deterministic vs. Bedrock candidates (when both ran), decides ExtractedFieldState (CONFIRMED/PENDING_CONFIRMATION/DISAGREEMENT) per data-model.md.

MarkPendingConfirmation.Comment: STUB - reached either from a RunDeterministicParser failure (no usable candidate at all) or from the normal path when a field needs human confirmation. Also the state responsible (per design §3) for deleting the transient OCR artifact when the run does NOT proceed to CompleteRun.

CompleteRun.Comment: STUB - terminal success state. Deletes the transient OCR artifact (design §3: the only point in the system that knows for certain no later state will read it) and marks ExtractionRun COMPLETED.
